_about: The papers the control room's Papers page shows. Made by tools/legal/make-legal-pdfs.py; the control room reads this file and each PDF from this repository's main branch.

papers.title: Sign-Up Form
papers.about: Fill in sections B and C (lots and fees), then send it with the terms and the Setup Questions. They fill in section A, initial and sign; you sign for Barnwright.

papers.title: Terms and Conditions
papers.about: Send it with the Sign-Up Form. Their owner also ticks I agree to it in the Dealer Center's first setup.

papers.title: Setup Questions
papers.about: Send it with the Sign-Up Form. They answer it and send it back with their logo, price sheet and photos, so you can set them up and build their buildings their way.

papers.title: Adding a New Customer
papers.about: Your steps from the day they say yes to the day they go live, and adding a lot later.
